pages.text: Tall sliding doors are available in every wood type, including bamboo. Right-click an empty-handed door to work it. Panels can stack together, allowing up to four panels in one door.$(br2)Which side you click decides which way it goes: click the half the panels are hinged on to slide the door open, or click the other half to slide it shut.

A single panel slides one block to the side, so leave enough room beside it. Doors placed next to each other can share their sliding space, letting you build wide sliding walls. To add another panel, right-click a door while holding the same door item; the side you place it from determines its sliding direction.
